review_type: Independent read-only content and visual review of the preproduction main manuscript
result: No unresolved material content or layout issue identified within the stated review scope. This is a preproduction manuscript, not an executed-study result or publication guarantee.

visual_review.findings: All 33 pages inspected on contact sheets; title/status, prospective-study section and both retained main evidence tables inspected at full page resolution. No observed clipped equations, overlapping paragraphs, broken tables, blank pages, or material page-break defect. Final page is naturally short. Contact sheets do not substitute for full-resolution inspection of every glyph.

content_checks.preproduction_status: Conspicuous dated notice above the abstract; abstract, Section 6 and reproducibility text explicitly distinguish the frozen unexecuted 32-repetition/256-task study from completed historical results.
content_checks.production_results: No invented production finding identified. Four G/P/K/R comparisons are future criteria, not outcomes; artificial implementation checks are explicitly not forecasting evidence.
content_checks.statistical_family: New family retains three nonlinear 3% superiority contrasts and one linear 5% noninferiority contrast over 32 independent repetition aggregates, with upper-gap Bonferroni paired-t endpoint. No pooling historical cohorts or treating overlapping origins as independent.
content_checks.conceptual_scope: Membership map is product-simplex; signed augmented raw descriptors and bounded transformed inputs are distinguished. Shared-bank enrichment differs from independently selected procedure comparisons. Direct observed-output readouts, conditional exact deterministic closure, stochastic conditional means, and future propagation evaluation remain distinct. No unsupported Markov/sufficiency/rollout claim identified.
content_checks.procedure_distinction: New representation-only heads have no retained baseline, residual target or C calibration. Separate block transformations explicitly differ from the historical joint-common transform; primary P-selected shared cap is distinguished from secondary independently selected caps.
content_checks.historical_evidence: Completed dimension six-claim and policy four-claim families retained; failures, descriptive natural-panel penalty, cohort identities, validation-based native dimension and rank restrictions retained. Generated numerical inputs and both retained main primary tables match the preserved full manuscript byte for byte.

resolved_issue.issue: Student quantile subscript order was inconsistent with the historical main sections.
resolved_issue.resolution: Root changed to t_{n-1,1-0.05/4} and defined t_{nu,p}; inspected in final page 14. This did not change numerical analysis.

limitations: Read-only source and document review; no TeX compilation was performed by this reviewer.
No production generation, fitting, evaluation, remote publication, or frozen-source edits were performed.
Historical numerical consistency was checked against preserved generated artifacts; this review is not an independent rerun of the historical simulations.
The new representation hierarchy remains empirically untested until the prescribed complete production study is executed and audited.
